name: SALUTE
recent: Salutica 近期有一系列企业活动：拟通过私募配售集资约 RM16.18m，同时其全资子公司获得一项价值约 RM2.85m 的装修工程合约。此外，公司有多项重大诉讼公告，以及大股东和董事的股权变动申报。
notable: 全资子公司 SLTC Venture 获得 Puncak Ecocity (Klang) 颁发的装修与维修工程合约，价值约 RM2.85m。
risks: 公司有多项重大诉讼公告，涉及法律程序。
私募配售可能对现有股东权益产生摊薄影响。
近期有多名大股东及董事申报股权变动，包括股份 cease 及权益变更。
earnings: 最新财报期间（2026-06-30）营收为 RM6.672m，环比增长 13.4%，但同比下跌 28.3%；净亏损为 RM4.563m，净亏损率为 68.4%，较上一季度的 103.4% 有所收窄。

recent_en: Salutica has had a series of corporate activities recently: it proposes to raise approximately RM16.18m via private placement and to diversify into property and construction; its wholly-owned subsidiary secured a renovation contract worth about RM2.85m. In addition, there are multiple material litigation announcements and filings on changes in substantial shareholders' and directors' interests.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary SLTC Venture accepted a letter of award from Puncak Ecocity (Klang) for renovation and repair works worth approximately RM2.85m.
The company proposes a private placement expected to raise approximately RM16.18m.
The company proposes to diversify its business into property and construction.
risks_en: The company has multiple material litigation announcements involving legal proceedings.
The private placement may have a dilutive effect on existing shareholders' interests.
There have been recent filings of changes in interests by several substantial shareholders and directors, including cessation of interests and changes in interests.
earnings_en: For the latest financial period ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM6.672m, up 13.4% qoq but down 28.3% yoy; net loss was RM4.563m with a net margin of -68.4%, narrowing from -103.4% in the previous quarter.
